scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "vite,tsc,electron" -c "cyan,blue,magenta" "cd ../frontend && npx vite --port 5174" "tsc --watch" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 dist/ipc/scanner.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron . --remote-debugging-port=9222"

scripts.uninstaller:dev: concurrently -k -n "vite,tsc,electron" -c "cyan,blue,magenta" "cd ../frontend && npx vite --port 5174" "tsc --watch" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5174 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development OTIX_UNINSTALLER=1 electron ."
